{{SameName|Nightshade|[[Nightshade (Unit)|Unit]] • [[Nightshade|Enemy]]}} {{UnitInfobox |title1 = Nightshade |image-static = NightshadeIcon.png |image-dynamic = NightshadeDynamic.png |pseudoxd = true |source = [[Biologist]] |level = 2 |type = Plant |lifespan = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Lifespan]]20s |health = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]400 |spawnrate = [[File:VehicleSpawn.png|20px|Spawnrate]]20s |damage_type = Single |ranged_damage = [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Damage]]50 |ranged_firerate = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]]3 |ranged_range = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]30 |hidden = N/A |lead = N/A |flying = {{Attr|Flying|Unit Level 0+}} }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Deals single dps that inflicts confusion.|In-Game Description}} }} ==Description== The '''Nightshade''' is a unit spawned by the [[Biologist]]. The [[Biologist]] is able to spawn the '''Nightshade''' starting from Level 3, as long as it selected in the unit queue. It spawns on ground within the [[Biologist]]'s range. The '''Nightshade's''' statistics are upgraded once the [[Biologist]] reaches Level 4. The '''Nightshade''' fires lasers at enemies, which deal damage and also confuses them. It will target a single enemy in its range and deal damage to it while causing it to walk backwards every 4 seconds. After 20 seconds have passed, it will disappear from the map and the [[Biologist]] will replace it with another plant. ==Appearance== The '''Nightshade''' is a nightshade flower which fires lasers at enemies. The flower itself is purple and yellow. ==Statistics== {{neow| $DPS$ = Damage / Firerate $MDPS$ = $DPS$ * Unit Queue $MREF$ = DPS is multiplied by the '''Biologist's''' unit queues.
{| class="wikitable stats-table" ! Level !! Health !! Damage !! Spawnrate !! Firerate !! Lifespan !! Range !! Confusion Time !! Confusion Cooldown !! Unit Queue !! Detections !! DPS !! Max DPS$MREF$ |- | 0 || 400 || 50 || 20 || 3 || 20 || 30 || 1 || 4 || 2 || Flying || $DPS$ || $MDPS$ |- | 1 || 800 || 135 || 20 || 2.75 || 20 || 35 || 1.25 || 4 || 3 || Flying || $DPS$ || $MDPS$ |}
}} ==Strategy== *The '''Nightshade''' can be used to stall enemies, as its attack confuse enemies, making them walk towards the exit. **The '''Nightshade''' cannot apply confusion to an enemy which has been recently confused, as each confusion applies a cooldown before an enemy can be confused again. ***This does not apply to just the '''Nightshade's''' confusion, as if an enemy has been confused through other sources, such as the [[Jester]] confusion bombs, the '''Nightshade''' will be unable to confuse it. ***Similarly, the '''Nightshade's''' confusion will also prevent other sources to apply it. *While the '''Nightshade''' has lower DPS than the [[Sunflower]], it does have higher range and it can confuse enemies, meaning it is still able to deal decent damage to single target enemies. *The '''Nightshade''' has flying detection, making it useful at clearing out and stalling [[Flying]] enemies. ==Sounds== {{Sounds| {{WeaponHeader|All skins}}{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! style{{=}}"width:30%;" |Sound ! style{{=}}"width:70%;" |Description |- |[[File:DefaultNightshadeFire.ogg]] |Firing sound |}}} }} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Ducky Battlepass - Tower Defense Simulator|Default skin on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Stickers}} BiologistMenaceSticker.png|Default skin on the [[Biologist Menace]] sticker. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} NightshadeUnitIconIG.png|In-game icon. }} ==Update History== *'''16 April 2025''' - [[v1.61.0]] **'''Nightshade''' added. **{{Bug}} Projectiles can be collided with. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **Firerate decreased due to the [[Firerate Bug]] getting fixed. **Statistical changes: ***'''Base''' ****Firerate decreased from 3.025 to 3. ***'''Level 1''' ****Firerate decreased from 2.775 to 2.75. ==Notes== {{TowerNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Nightshade}}
